story: Drew the paper's weekly comic strip and quietly became one of the best animators I know. Works on an animated series in Los Angeles. Still sends me hand-drawn birthday cards.

moments.title: Studio visit on video
moments.transcript: He showed me his storyboard wall. It stretched around a whole office.

moments.title: Graduation drawing
moments.text: He gave me a drawing of the newspaper staff as raccoons.

moments.title: Met at Student newspaper
moments.transcript: Jasper, the cartoonist. His strip made the paper worth reading.

name: Cass Whitaker
story: Our club captain. Taught me the forehand and how to lose with a smile. Still lives in Ann Arbor, teaches PE and coaches the club.

moments.title: Phone call
moments.transcript: She is coaching the club to a regional final. Wants me to come and cheer, wearing the old jersey.

moments.title: Alumni tournament
moments.text: I played for forty minutes, pulled a muscle, and loved every second.

moments.title: Met at Club ultimate
moments.transcript: Cass, captain. Handed me a disc and said throw it to anyone but me.

name: Ty Nakamura
story: Fastest cutter on the team. Moved to the Bay Area for an engineering job and plays on a competitive league on weekends. Good at everything, annoying about it.

todos.text: Meet for coffee on my SF trip
Ask him for a startup intro

moments.title: Phone call
moments.transcript: He is thinking about leaving his company for a smaller one. Wanted a second opinion on the design culture there.

moments.title: SF visit
moments.text: We watched his league game from the sidelines and he scored four times.

moments.title: Met at Club ultimate
moments.transcript: Ty, the quiet one with the unreasonable vertical.

name: Rosa Delgado
story: Played defense like she was personally offended. A physician assistant at a Brooklyn hospital, plays in a co-ed league on Randall's Island and keeps the club's group chat alive from three states.

todos.text: Ask her to look at my sore shoulder

moments.title: League game
moments.transcript: Played the second half. We lost by two. Afterward she walked me to the train and quizzed me on my knee.

moments.title: Her housewarming
moments.text: Brought a plant. She gave it to the neighbor, the plant is thriving.

moments.title: Met at Club ultimate
moments.transcript: Rosa, the best defender I have ever tried to get away from. She said hi after the game and I said I was sorry.

name: Finn Oliver
story: Handler on the team and the best passer I know. Does environmental assessments for developers in Portland. Plans the club's annual alumni camping weekend.

todos.text: Reserve a campsite for the alumni weekend

moments.title: Phone call
moments.transcript: He is cutting his work travel in half and is delighted about it. Plans to bike the entire coast.

moments.title: Camping weekend
moments.text: Eight of us in a field with one burner. Burned the pancakes and ate them anyway.

moments.title: Met at Club ultimate
moments.transcript: Finn, the handler. Passed the disc so accurately I assumed he was a robot.

name: June Park
story: Played ultimate in a headband and drew buildings on the sidelines. Now a graduate student of architecture in Cambridge. Wants to design a school someday.

moments.title: Studio visit
moments.transcript: She walked me through her model of a school. The windows were arranged by the angle of afternoon light.

moments.title: Last game of college
moments.text: We cried on the field. Someone brought orange slices.

moments.title: Met at Club ultimate
moments.transcript: June, the one drawing a building on a napkin during halftime.

name: Chloe Bernard
story: Studied fashion design a floor above me and we shared studio snacks for three years. After a few assistant jobs she is now a designer at a small Brooklyn label. Throws a studio sale twice a year and everyone dresses up for it.

todos.text: Go to the autumn studio sale

moments.title: Studio sale planning
moments.transcript: She asked me to design the invitation. The theme is deconstructed tailoring and the dress code is tailoring that has been through a washing machine.

moments.title: Fashion week show
moments.text: Stood at the back of her label's tiny show. She came out at the end and walked off the runway to hug me.

moments.title: Her first label job
moments.text: Celebrated at a bar in Greenpoint. She had her sketchbook on the table the whole night.

moments.title: Met at Design school studio
moments.transcript: Chloe, fashion design. She pinned my sweater so it would fit and called it a mood.

name: Dev Malhotra
story: Industrial design classmate who made a lamp so good the professor kept it. Designs lighting for a small Brooklyn company and shares a studio space in Gowanus.

moments.title: Studio visit
moments.transcript: A shared room full of lamps in various stages. He gave me a prototype to take home.

moments.title: Holiday sale
moments.text: I bought a lamp I still use every night.

moments.title: Met at Design school studio
moments.transcript: Dev, industrial design. He fixed my model with a single clamp.

name: Isabel Correa
story: The typography nerd in our year, with a map of Mexico City's best hand-painted signs on her wall. Runs a small brand studio in her hometown. Always sends me type specimens.

todos.text: Send my wordmark for her opinion

moments.title: Video call
moments.transcript: She walked me through a rebrand she did for a taqueria. Every sign painted by hand.

moments.title: Visited Mexico City
moments.text: She took me to a letterpress shop and gave me a type specimen book.

moments.title: Met at Design school studio
moments.transcript: Isabel, the type person. She corrected my kerning in front of the class.

name: Wes Tran
story: Interaction design classmate who was always a few years ahead. Now a design director at a Bay Area company. Gave me the push to leave Chicago for New York.

todos.text: Meet him on my SF trip
Ask him for a portfolio review

moments.title: Phone call
moments.transcript: He told me he is hiring a senior designer. I said I was happy where I am and he said ok but think about it.

moments.title: Call before the move
moments.text: He talked me out of two excuses for staying in Chicago. I moved in August.

moments.title: Met at Design school studio
moments.transcript: Wes, interaction design. He asked what I was most afraid of in my project and made me start there.

name: Noor Aziz
story: Illustration major who ended up doing motion graphics for a London studio. Her title sequences are the best part of any show. Sends me playlists when she is working late.

moments.title: Video call
moments.transcript: She was in the middle of a deadline and shared her screen for a minute. A title sequence that looked like moving watercolor.

moments.title: London trip
moments.text: Dinner near her studio. She sketched the whole table on a napkin.

moments.title: Met at Design school studio
moments.transcript: Noor, the illustrator who drew on the studio wall and was never told off.

name: Professor Margaret Holloway
story: My studio professor and the person who first said I could be a designer. Writes me a thoughtful reply to every email in the same afternoon. Retiring in two years.

todos.text: Send her my new case study

moments.title: Coffee in Ann Arbor
moments.transcript: She gave me the best critique I have had in years. Told me I design for the room and not for the person.

moments.title: Reference call
moments.text: She vouched for me for the New York job. I got the offer the next day.

moments.title: Met at Design studio class
moments.transcript: Professor Holloway. She wrote 'start again' on my first project and I still think she was right.

name: Anil Sethi
story: Taught the design history seminar and made me read way too much. Now writing a book on the Bauhaus and its imitators. Still answers any email with a reading list.

moments.title: Email
moments.transcript: He sent a list of eleven books after I asked one question. I read two and wrote him a thank you.

moments.title: Thesis feedback
moments.text: He wrote 'good, now delete half' on page one.

moments.title: Met at Design history seminar
moments.transcript: Professor Sethi, design history. Assigned forty pages a night.

name: Astrid Nielsen
story: My buddy from the Danish design school in my semester abroad. Taught me to bike in the rain and to say tak for everything. Designs chairs for a small Copenhagen furniture company.

todos.text: Ask about a chair for the apartment

moments.title: Video call
moments.transcript: She showed me a chair that took a year to design. Asked what I thought about the armrest.

moments.title: Visited Copenhagen
moments.text: She cycled us across the city, and we ate open sandwiches on the water.

moments.title: Met at Study abroad, design school
moments.transcript: Astrid, my study abroad buddy. She laughed at my first attempt at a Danish word, kindly.

name: Caio Barbosa
story: Another exchange student in Copenhagen, who taught the whole dorm to cook feijoada. Now an architect in São Paulo working on social housing.

moments.title: Phone call
moments.transcript: He sent photos of a social housing project he has been on for three years. The balconies looked like gardens.

moments.title: Last night in Copenhagen
moments.text: He made a huge pot of beans. We ate until midnight and then walked in the snow.

moments.title: Met at Study abroad, design school
moments.transcript: Caio, from Brazil. He turned our dorm kitchen into a restaurant on Sundays.

name: Emily Chung
story: Studied abroad in the same semester and we stayed best friends. Now an architect at a firm in Long Island City and my frequent coffee partner. We trade apartment layouts like trading cards.

moments.title: Coffee in LIC
moments.transcript: She is leading a small community center project. Asked if I would help with signage.

moments.title: Apartment tour
moments.text: She walked through my Bushwick place and suggested moving the bed. She was right.

moments.title: Met at Study abroad, design school
moments.transcript: Emily, from my program. We got lost together in Copenhagen on the first night.

name: Malik Johnson
story: Sang tenor in my friend group's a cappella group, which I was only allowed to attend as a fan. Now picks songs for TV shows in Los Angeles. Sends playlists and takes no requests.

moments.title: Phone call
moments.transcript: He got a song into a finale and called me from the sidewalk. We replayed the scene on speaker.

moments.title: Spring concert
moments.text: They sang a song I will never get out of my head.

moments.title: Met at A cappella group
moments.transcript: Malik, tenor. He told me I could only come if I clapped on the beat.

name: Gabriela Ruiz
story: Co-op housemate who ran the house garden. Now studies housing and health in Washington Heights. Organizes a neighborhood potluck on the last Saturday of every month.

todos.text: Bring a dish to the potluck

moments.title: Potluck
moments.transcript: Forty people in a courtyard. She introduced me to a landlord who actually fixes things.

moments.title: My first New York potluck
moments.text: Brought store-bought cookies and was gently roasted.

moments.title: Met at Co-op house
moments.transcript: Gabi, the co-op manager. She handed me a chore chart on the first day.

name: Lou Marchetti
story: My barber for five years. Born three blocks from the shop and has an opinion on every pizza place in Brooklyn. Never lets me leave without a story.

moments.title: Haircut
moments.transcript: He told me about the time he cut a famous musician's hair in the middle of a blackout. I do not believe him and I love it.

moments.title: Shop anniversary
moments.text: Forty years of the shop. He cried and then charged me double.

moments.title: Met at Barbershop
moments.transcript: Lou, the barber. He asked what I do, and then told me what I should do instead.

story: My doctor in Brooklyn. Reads my chart before the appointment and asks about work without being asked. Ran the NYC marathon last year and told me to rest on stairs.

moments.title: Annual physical
moments.transcript: All numbers fine. She told me to take lunch away from my desk, then wrote it on the chart.

moments.title: Flu shot
moments.text: She talked me through her marathon training while she gave the injection.

moments.title: Met at Doctor's office
moments.transcript: Dr. Feldman, my doctor. She asked whether I sleep and then whether I like my job.

moments.title: Cleaning
moments.transcript: He showed me an x-ray of a wisdom tooth and told me about his grandson's science project.

moments.title: Emergency crown
moments.text: He fit me in on a Friday evening and wouldn't let me pay for the follow up.

moments.title: Met at Dentist's office
moments.transcript: Dr. Liu, the dentist. My mom already told him I would come.
